templates.action: SS fields the grounder and throws to 1B; 1B makes the only putout.
templates.premise: No other play is attempted (no double play, no play at another base).

templates.action: Grounder through the infield into left field; no out is made, no throw is credited.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Grounder down the line into the left-field corner; the batter-runner stops on second.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error; the batter-runner's final base is second.

templates.action: SS misplays the grounder (E6); no out is made.
templates.premise: One error by one fielder; never reclassified as a fielder's choice or a compound error.
Caught in the air: the only putout is the batter's; nobody is doubled off.

templates.action: Line drive falls in front of the center fielder.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Line drive into the right-center gap; the batter-runner stops on second.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Line drive into the right-field corner; the batter-runner stops on third.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Line drive over the outfield fence (out of the playing field).
templates.premise: Out-of-the-park home run (owner D2); inside-the-park home runs are not generated.

templates.action: SS misplays the line drive (E6); no out is made.

templates.premise: Deep fly ball in the center fielder's range, beyond the infielders' ordinary effort: the Infield Fly rule does not apply.

templates.action: Fly ball drops in front of the center fielder.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error; beyond the infielders' ordinary effort.

templates.action: Fly ball drops in the gap; the batter-runner stops on second.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Fly ball over the right fielder; the batter-runner stops on third.
templates.premise: Safe hit: no putout, no error.

templates.action: Fly ball over the outfield fence (out of the playing field).
CF drops the fly ball (E8); no out is made.
templates.premise: A ball the center fielder could ordinarily catch, beyond the infielders' ordinary effort.
A pop-up an infielder catches with ordinary effort: with runners on first and second (or loaded) and fewer than two outs this is an Infield Fly; the caught ball gives the same record.

templates.action: Pop-up drops in shallow center field, beyond any infielder's ordinary effort; CF retrieves it.
templates.premise: Not catchable by an infielder with ordinary effort: the Infield Fly rule does NOT apply (by premise), whatever the runners.

templates.action: Pop-up in shallow center field, beyond any infielder's ordinary effort; CF could ordinarily catch it and drops it (E8).
templates.premise: Not catchable by an infielder with ordinary effort (no Infield Fly, by premise); catchable by the outfielder in his own range.
